adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, the code appends `I18n.t('embed.imported_from', link: "#{url}")` directly into `contents`, and imported posts are created with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` so `Post#cook` returns `raw` without sanitization. The only guard is `url =~ /^https?\:\/\//`, which does not prevent quotes or angle brackets in the remainder of the URL, so a crafted URL like `http://evil.com/'>
